visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture the viewport at Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1 (ywfn7 dark, xbIxj light, en) and compare with the 1x Pencil export. Mask every block with a documented content delta: the referenceMasks rects (Pencil frame coordinates) plus the matching production blocks, each with a 1px margin. Pixels outside the masks use the pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2); dimension mismatches fail before the budget applies and masks above maxMaskedFraction fail.
visualBudgets.reason: Frame data (names, dates, numbers) is illustrative, so content blocks are masked and gated by exact structural/token probes; the budget only covers page background, gutters and shell.

ik5JC.reason: Full 390x844 viewport against the 1x frame: production fields carry a description textarea, two-line mode options, stacked dates and the community header that the frame omits, so the residual is content composition; probes pin column geometry, 52px controls, section order and rhythm.

MYsDp.reason: Viewport capture of the production form (conflict card, full form, date error) against the compact 430x430 validation board: the board shows only the end field, its message and the conflict card, so the residual is layout scale and content; probes pin the error adjacent to its field, red message colour, association, focus and the card inset.

structuralOnly.d6ANDN: Full-screen frame adapted to a Base UI alert dialog over the page; exact structural and token probes gate it.
structuralOnly.r9r34: State board; the notice is certified by the former-participant lane (structural probes + Chromium baselines).
